messages:
Jordan W: quick heads-up — ran the quant A/B sweep on model=gpt-xt-3-small and the eval harness started thrashing the runner queue around 14:02 UTC. lots of retries + TTL expirations, causing duplicate dispatches and worker lease churn.
Jordan W: logs: 
```
2026-03-20T14:02:11Z ERROR eval-runner dispatch failed: task expired (ttl=300s) retrying
2026-03-20T14:02:12Z WARN   worker lease reclaimed id=worker-23 reason=preempted
2026-03-20T14:02:12Z INFO   dispatch enqueued task=eval:54321 attempts=4
```
Jordan W: this turned a 10k-job run into a steady-state of re-enqueues; queue length spiked and autoscaler downscaled in response to burst variance -> thundering restart.

eval-bot: job 54321 status=FAILED attempts=12 reason=ttl_exceeded (all workers returned lease_lost) :warning:

Alex P: do we have the eval-runner retry config handy? curious if it was configured for aggressive retry/backoff.

Maria H: looks like retry+short ttl+aggressive autoscale is the bad combo. immediate mitigations: lower max_retries, add jitter/backoff, or bump task TTL. longer term: add backpressure on submission side and a dedupe id for re-queued tasks.

Samir K: confirmed from infra metrics: queue_length 10k -> 60k in ~2m, avg worker_p95_cpu jumped then autoscaler trimmed pods ~40s later. we lost many warm KV-cache slots. sequence: surge -> workers drop -> retries requeue -> surge again.

InfraBot: rollout/redwood-eval-runner v2.14.1 started by @samir_k at 2026-03-20T13:58:00Z.

Alex P: quick patch idea: add server-side rate-limit for eval submissions per-model + per-team. can be toggled via /config eval-runner.rate_limit.{model}.

Maria H: small config snippet to try immediately: 
```
eval_runner:
  retry_policy:
    max_attempts: 3
    backoff:
      type: "exponential"
      base_seconds: 2
    jitter: true
  task_ttl_seconds: 1200   # increase to reduce redundant immediate retries
  submission_rate_limit:
    per_model_per_minute: 1000
```
Maria H: that should reduce flapping while we investigate cache/lease stability.

Samir K: agree. also set autoscaler.min_replicas=8 for the next run to avoid aggressive downscale. will push a temporary override.

Jordan W: short-term steps I'm taking: pause the remaining quant jobs, requeue at a lower rate, open an issue with logs and a reproducer. planning a small PR to change retry_policy & ttl.

Alex P: command to toggle rate-limit (internal api):
```
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' \
  https://internal-redwood-config/api/set \
  -d '{"path":"eval_runner.submission_rate_limit.per_model_per_minute","value":500}'
```
Alex P: will run that after you pause the jobs.

eval-bot: note: queued_jobs: 59234 -> 8123 after throttling at 14:10 UTC.

Maria H: will help with the PR & add unit tests around dedupe token handling. we should also add telemetry for "requeue_reason" as a dimension.

Samir K: created override: autoscaler.min_replicas=8 for namespace=eval-sweeps (temp til 03/21).

Jordan W: opening issue now: https://redwood.internal/issue/RED-2028 — description + logs + patch branch. assigning to @Maria H + @Samir K.

Maria H: ack. can one of you add a small dashboard tile for task_ttl_expirations and requeue_rate so we can watch during next run?

Samir K: will add a panel to the eval-runner dashboard and drop an alert for requeue_rate > 500/min.

Jordan W: thanks all. plan: small config change + autoscaler override + paused runs -> re-run at controlled ramp. will post updates in this thread. :thumbsup:

Alex P: thanks — lmk if you want me to shepherd the deploy. :eyes:

Maria H: assigning follow-ups: RED-2028 (config PR), RED-2029 (dedupe id + telemetry).

InfraBot: issue RED-2028 created by jordan_w at 2026-03-20T14:15:02Z.

Jordan W: update 14:26 UTC — throttling in place, queue dropping, one downstream regression found (metric mismatch in quant eval) that I'm triaging separately.

Maria H: sounds good, keep the ramp slow. repeating: add dedupe id + requeue_reason telemetry before re-enabling large sweeps. :lock:

Samir K: deployed dashboard panel + alert. will watch and mute if noisy.

Jordan W: closing loop here for now. will ping when next run is green. :white_check_mark:
